title: Certifying Provenance of Scientific Datasets with Self-sovereign Identity and Verifiable Credentials
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. Its focus is on certifying the provenance of scientific datasets using cryptographic methods.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The key findings relate to a proposed technical framework for using self-sovereign identity and verifiable credentials to certify attributes of digital datasets, such as their ethical sourcing, in a cryptographically secure and verifiable manner.
